El loop básico del juego, en 5 pasos:: The game's basic loop, in 5 steps:
Usá `/chop` o `/mine` para conseguir rec: Use `/chop` or `/mine` to get basic resources.
Usá `/forge` para ver las recetas de cad: Use `/forge` to see each zone's recipes and craft weapons and amulets: they equip themselves (to change, sell the one you're wearing at `/taberna`). Don't know what to farm? `/tips` tells you what you're missing.
Usá `/hunt` (manual) o `aa ah` (automáti: Use `/hunt` (manual) or `aa ah` (automatic) to earn Gold, XP and monster drops. In manual fights each class has a special ability (green button, see `/profile`); automatic mode only attacks normally.
Usá `/shop` para comprar comida y `/heal: Use `/shop` to buy food and `/heal` to heal (careful, healing in combat gives the enemy an extra turn!). Losing a fight costs you the XP of your level and 5% of the gold you carry: what you keep in the bank (`/bank`) is safe.
Cada día hay 3 misiones y cada semana 2: Every day there are 3 missions and every week 2 (`/missions`), and there are tiered achievements (`/achievements`). They count on their own while you play and give gold, XP and boxes to open with `/open`. Daily ones reset at midnight, Uruguay time.
